title: Remove Settings raw triage flat exports
summary: Removed five transitional flat Settings Raw Triage aliases while preserving the helpers on mediaPipelineSettingsView.
reason: WebView flat export cleanup remains an active opportunistic workstream. The Raw Triage helpers are still namespace-exported and passed internally through Settings module dependency injection, while Raw Action Plan aliases remain flat because Home still consumes them directly.
behavior_before: settingsView.js exposed Settings Raw Triage row, status, summary, detail, and render helpers both through mediaPipelineSettingsView and as direct window.* compatibility aliases.
behavior_after: The Settings Raw Triage helpers remain available through mediaPipelineSettingsView and existing Settings module dependency injection, but no longer create direct window.* aliases. Raw Action Plan helpers intentionally remain flat for the current Home-page consumer. The global export inventory and WebView public contract baseline now report 441 flat exports.
tests_added: tests.webview.test_webview_handbrake_settings_ui.WebViewHandBrakeSettingsUiTests.test_settings_raw_triage_helpers_are_namespace_only_exports asserts the Raw Triage helpers remain present while direct flat aliases are absent.
manual_validation: Baseline targeted test failed before source edit because window.settingsRawTriageRows still existed.

rg "window\.(settingsRawTriageRows|settingsRawTriageStatus|settingsRawTriageSummaryLines|settingsRawTriageDetailLines|renderSettingsRawTriage)" apps\desktop\webview\static tests\webview Docs\inventories -n returned no matches after removal.
rollback_plan: Revert this packet to restore the five Settings direct window.* Raw Triage aliases, regenerate the WebView public contract baseline, godfile map, split candidates, global export inventory, summaries, and restore the flat export count from 441 to 446.
notes: Remove five Settings Raw Triage direct window aliases while keeping namespace exports.
